author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: ऊष्मपाः पितरः "ऊष्मभागा हि पितर" इति श्रुतेः । गन्धर्वादीनां सङ्घाः ॥ ११.२२॥
translation: The Rudras, Adityas, Vasus, and those who are called Sadhyas, Visvedevas, the two Aswins and the Maruts and the Pitris; the thronging Gandharvas Yakshas, Asuras, Siddhas, behold Thee all immersed in wonder and in wonder only. (22).
